# Reconcile PRs

The `reconcile` command updates the knowledge base by processing any merged pull requests that were missed since the last compilation. This feature ensures that the knowledge base remains current with the latest changes from the repository.

- `knowledge_compiler/cli.py` — `knowledge_compiler.cli.reconcile_cmd`
